question.problem:
In an airport, $58%$ of the flights arrive early. Using the normal approximation to the binomial distribution, approximate the probability that if $60$ flights are picked at random, then $40$ of them will arrive early. Give your answer to three decimal places.

*Hint: The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution. *

| $z$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ | $\,0.06\,$ | $\,0.07\,$ | $\,0.08\,$ | $\,0.09\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,1.2\,$ | $\,0.8907\,$ | $\,0.8925\,$ | $\,0.8944\,$ | $\,0.8962\,$ | $\,0.8980\,$ | $\,0.8997\,$ | $\,0.9015\,$ |
| $\,1.3\,$ | $\,0.9082\,$ | $\,0.9099\,$ | $\,0.9115\,$ | $\,0.9131\,$ | $\,0.9147\,$ | $\,0.9162\,$ | $\,0.9177\,$ |
| $\,1.4\,$ | $\,0.9236\,$ | $\,0.9251\,$ | $\,0.9265\,$ | $\,0.9279\,$ | $\,0.9292\,$ | $\,0.9306\,$ | $\,0.9319\,$ |
question.worked_solution:
Given a binomial random variable $X∼B(n,p),$ if 

- $np>5,$ and

- $n(1-p)>5,$

we can approximate $X$ as a normal random variable $Y$ with mean $\mu =np$ and variance ${\sigma }^{2}=np(1-p),$ that is, 

$$
Y∼N(np,np(1-p)).
$$

Here, we have $n=60$ and $p=0.58.$ Therefore, 

$$
\begin{aligned}np & =60\cdot 0.58 \\  & =34.8 \\  & >5\,✓ \\ n(1-p) & =60\cdot (1-0.58) \\  & =25.2 \\  & >5.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can approximate our binomial random variable $X$ with a normal random variable $Y$ with mean

$$
\mu =np=(60)(0.58)=34.8
$$

and variance

$$
{\sigma }^{2}=np(1-p)=(60)(0.58)(1-0.58)=14.62.
$$

That is, we can approximate $X$ by $Y∼N(34.8,14.62).$

Now, we can approximate the desired probability $P(X=40).$ Using a continuity correction, we have

$$
P(X=40)≈P(39.5\le Y\le 40.5).
$$

To compute this probability, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(39.5\le Y\le 40.5) & =P(\frac{39.5-34.8}{\sqrt{14.62}}\le Z\le \frac{40.5-34.8}{\sqrt{14.62}}) \\  & ≈P(1.23\le Z\le 1.49) \\  & =P(Z\le 1.49)-P(Z<1.23) \\  & =P(Z\le 1.49)-P(Z\le 1.23) \\  & =Φ(1.49)-Φ(1.23) \\  & =0.9319-0.8907 \\  & =0.0412\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
P(X=40)≈0.041.
$$

Note: Using a software package for the approximation gives a probability of $0.0415.$
